verdict.rationale: Least-privilege access is a fair question for an autonomous agent that holds user credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only all-or-nothing Google Workspace linking and revocation, plus a Vault for whole credentials. The least-privilege setups reported are user-side workarounds: one reviewer stored only a single credential and used a spend-capped card, and another had the agent create its own account. Nothing shows Instinct issuing scoped API credentials itself, and the vendor exposes no API or developer surface.
